'**Boost** / If an item or equipment was banished from boosting this, this gets +1{p}.' Mechanologist Action - Attack.

SHAPE copied verbatim from SHIPPED evo/sprocket_rocket_blue.json (same printed clause) and re-checked against the handlers: WHILE_STATIC fires only on RECALC_ATTACK_POWER (interpreter.py), SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines the pump to this card's own attack, BOOST_BANISHED_IS (condition_types.py:1147) matches each banished card's types UNION subtypes via _norm so 'Item'/'Equipment' hit the DB spellings, and MODIFY_ATTACK applies transiently in the stage-8 static window so repeated recalculations never stack.

Release notes satisfied by the condition's construction: (1) only the banished card's TYPE is tested, so it need not be a Mechanologist card; (2) boost() records what IT banished on THIS card's boost_banished list, so cards banished for other cards' boosts are invisible here.

Printed **Boost** is in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field (ability_keywords.boost) - deliberately NOT authored; re-authoring a printed keyword is a defect. The +1{p} is a JSON-authored power bonus, not a conditional printed keyword, so no conditional-keyword strip is needed.
